description: Genomic context map of the four ASA-route genes and the final GO decision table
code:
import os, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt, matplotlib.patches as mp
os.makedirs("provenance",exist_ok=True)
df=pd.read_csv("provenance/bt4612_genomic_neighbourhoods.csv")

anchors=["BT_4612","BT_0674","BT_1099","BT_3394"]
titles={"BT_4612":"BT_4612  CASDH/CAPADH-family dehydrogenase (target)",
        "BT_0674":"BT_0674  casdc, carboxynorspermidine/carboxyspermidine decarboxylase",
        "BT_1099":"BT_1099  sole PF00491 ureohydrolase",
        "BT_3394":"BT_3394  speA, arginine decarboxylase"}
fig,axes=plt.subplots(4,1,figsize=(14,7.5))
for ax,a in zip(axes,anchors):
    sub=df[df.anchor==a].sort_values("offset")
    for _,r in sub.iterrows():
        x=r.offset; anchor=(x==0)
        ax.add_patch(mp.FancyArrow(x-0.42,0,0.84,0,width=0.34,head_width=0.34,head_length=0.16,
                                   length_includes_head=True,
                                   color="#c44e52" if anchor else "#b8c4d4",ec="k",lw=0.5))
        lab=str(r.locus).replace("BT_","")
        ax.text(x,0.33,lab,ha="center",fontsize=7.5)
        nmtxt=str(r.gene) if isinstance(r.gene,str) and r.gene and r.gene!="nan" else str(r.protein)[:26]
        ax.text(x,-0.40,nmtxt,ha="center",fontsize=6.6,rotation=0)
    ax.set_xlim(-4.8,4.8); ax.set_ylim(-0.75,0.65); ax.axis("off")
    ax.set_title(titles[a],fontsize=9,loc="left")
fig.suptitle("The four genes of the aspartate-semialdehyde spermidine route in B. thetaiotaomicron are dispersed:\n"
             "no operon, and no polyamine-related gene within four loci of any of them",fontsize=10.5)
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0,0,1,0.93]); plt.show()

GO=[
 {"GO_term":"GO:0047134 carboxyspermidine dehydrogenase activity","aspect":"MF","current_or_proposed":"provisional CASDH assignment in pathway diagram",
  "lead_action":"do not assert","basis":"only the PANTHER subfamily name and the pathway diagram support it; the 96.7%-identical ortholog was reassigned away from it (PMID 42754158)","strength":"not supported"},
 {"GO_term":"carboxynorspermidine dehydrogenase activity","aspect":"MF","current_or_proposed":"implied by PANTHER PTHR43796 title",
  "lead_action":"do not assert (positively excluded)","basis":"no fold-III ODC or LDC in the genome (PF01276/PF03709/PF03711 = 0); no de novo 1,3-diaminopropane route","strength":"refuted by amine supply"},
 {"GO_term":"carboxyaminopropylagmatine dehydrogenase activity","aspect":"MF","current_or_proposed":"not currently asserted",
  "lead_action":"do not pre-emptively assert","basis":"best-supported guess (PMID 42754158, 43093060, 37878710) but rests on in vitro orthology transfer; no assay of BT_4612; no settled GO term","strength":"suggestive only"},
 {"GO_term":"GO:0016646 oxidoreductase activity, CH-NH donor, NAD(P) acceptor","aspect":"MF","current_or_proposed":"proposed replacement",
  "lead_action":"adopt (generalize to this level)","basis":"chemistry is certain from fold and family; substrate compound is not","strength":"supported"},
 {"GO_term":"GO:0050661 NADP binding","aspect":"MF","current_or_proposed":"proposed addition",
  "lead_action":"adopt","basis":"33/33 NADP-contacting residues of PDB 8DEB identical in BT_4612; 2'-phosphate held by S34, R35, T36, K39, K286; Ala33 where an NAD enzyme carries Asp","strength":"strongly supported"},
 {"GO_term":"GO:0008295 spermidine biosynthetic process","aspect":"BP","current_or_proposed":"retain",
  "lead_action":"retain at ISS/IC strength","basis":"de novo spermidine in polyamine-free medium and Δcasdc phenotype (PMID 27118128); no SpeE/SpeD in genome; BT_4612 is the sole PF03435/PF16653 protein","strength":"supported by pathway necessity, not by assay of BT_4612"},
 {"GO_term":"any CC term","aspect":"CC","current_or_proposed":"none",
  "lead_action":"no recommendation","basis":"nothing tested; cytoplasm would be pathway inference only","strength":"untested"},
]
g=pd.DataFrame(GO); g.to_csv("provenance/bt4612_go_decision_table_final.csv",index=False)
print(g.to_string(index=False,max_colwidth=58))
print("\nsaved provenance/bt4612_go_decision_table_final.csv")
